summary: Fixed EventService::update to atomically emit source deletion and target creation on calendar moves, and added 6 regression tests covering the move path, rollback safety, imported-write rejection, and two-calendar sync-token behavior.
important_context: Move path in EventService::update now records 'deleted' on source + 'created' on target (not 'updated'), and updates caldav_event_resources.calendar_id to the target. The source 'deleted' change carries resource_name for sync-collection href resolution.
